field_evidence: Official register proposal explicitly identifies demolition of the existing garage and replacement with one new 2.5 bay garage including a home office within the roof. Proposed Site/Block Plan AL 10 002 - D, Proposed elevations (with garage) AL 10 010 - D, and Proposed garage layouts and elevations AL 10 006 - A support the same single planned replacement garage. Existing barn/range conversion and reconstruction works are not counted as additional distinct new structures.
